coverage_notes: Supplementary bounded recall watch, not the production nationwide collector. Twelve targeted searches across sole/last/full-service grocery closure or fire, disaster-related food-distribution cancellations, abrupt pantry/food-bank access reduction, and official immediate SNAP/WIC/EBT service interruptions; searches returned usable coverage. No new qualifying U.S. disruption verifiable as first reported within the observed hourly window. Excluded older Latta SC grocery-store closure; Oct 7 Prodisee Pantry Stockton AL Oct 10 weather cancellation (outside window and previously discoverable); general Oct 10 Hurricane Isaias impacts without evidence of newly canceled food provision; routine food calendars, promotion, unrelated results, and duplicates. Web result indexes have limited minute-level freshness; zero results means none verified, not nationwide absence. No approval, publication, production-collector or scheduling modifications.
